name: Wikimedia Pageviews API
description: Hourly, daily and monthly view counts for any Wikipedia article in any language since 2015, plus top-article rankings per day. A remarkably clean proxy for public attention: what people looked up, when, and in which language.

access.auth_note: no key, but send a real User-Agent - the default library agents are blocked
access.size_hint: the raw dumps at dumps.wikimedia.org are ~50 GB/year
access.rate_limit: 100 requests/second across the REST API; be far below that

recipes.title: Daily views for one article over a year
recipes.code:
curl -s -H 'User-Agent: my-project/1.0 (you@example.com)' \
  'https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/metrics/pageviews/per-article/en.wikipedia/all-access/user/Wimbledon/daily/20240101/20241231' \
  | python3 -c "import json,sys;[print(i['timestamp'][:8], i['views']) for i in json.load(sys.stdin)['items'][:10]]"

gotchas.trap: The article title must be exactly as it appears in the URL, with underscores, and it is case sensitive after the first letter.
gotchas.fix: Resolve the title through the Wikipedia API first; redirects are counted separately from their target.

gotchas.trap: agent=all-agents includes bots and spiders and can be several times the human number.
gotchas.fix: Use /user/ unless you specifically want automated traffic.
